purpose: Eight subdued leaf variations for the realism revision; original transparent base-color atlas
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: realistic video-game foliage BASE COLOR and ALPHA atlas, an original digital botanical scan, not a scene or illustration. Produce one landscape image with a strict 4-column by 2-row equal-cell grid: exactly EIGHT isolated ordinary English ivy leaves on a truly transparent background. Every leaf fits its own square cell without touching adjacent cells. Each petiole is at the bottom; main blade tip points up. Real small mature Hedera helix juvenile leaves with organic rounded lobes, unequal left and right sides, occasional shallow 3-lobed blades and deeper 5-lobed blades, subtly varied outlines. Show a useful range of natural shapes, sizes and minor edge damage. Most leaves a restrained medium-to-dark green with subtle olive variation; only one slightly lighter new leaf, no chartreuse or autumn colors. Natural veins are fine and LOW CONTRAST, close to the surrounding green; do not draw white diagram-like lines or golden outlines. Realistic restrained waxy cuticle, minute surface detail, natural imperfect organic blades. Flat diffuse cross-polarized scan lighting for an albedo texture: remove directional highlights, remove cast shadows and background. No twigs or whole plants; only short green-brown petioles on individual leaves. The result must look like photographed real ivy leaves, not glossy plastic, stars, clip art, watercolor or a botanical diagram. Clean detailed alpha silhouettes and enough transparent margin to use each leaf separately. No text, grid lines, labels, border, painted checkerboard, vignette or presentation effects. Aim for 2048x1024 pixels, two rows of four leaves.
layout: Four columns, two rows, eight individual leaves; original pixels preserved.
